key_invariant: Recover missed critical milestones, not skipped weeks.

must_catch_up.description: Banners/events that are meta/counter/progression-critical. Cannot be skipped post-merge.
examples: system unlock events (boss intro, tower intro, titan intro, castle intro, guild war intro, pvp season intro)
must_catch_up.recovery_requirement: Banner pool must include or rerun-equivalent.

optional_catch_up.description: Useful reruns, non-core heroes, valuable but farmable resources, medium prestige cosmetics.
examples: zodiac house events with non-critical rewards
optional_catch_up.recovery_requirement: Bundle into compressed shop or shorter rerun window if budget allows.

compress.description: Material weeks, minor shops, generic resource events, normal top-up support.
compress.recovery_requirement: Compressed into Merge Shop and Catch-Up Bundle. No banner pool entry.

skip.description: Generic lucky wheels, minor gold weeks, login filler, low-impact top-up, non-exclusive cosmetics if rerun elsewhere.
